additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We opened the ticket 0468841 a few days ago because a customer tried to charge the car on the charger n. 170002722 thru Type 2 plug, but the recharge was automatically interrupted.
Is it possible to better understand analyzing logs on the 19th of December at 3:13:53 p.m. (CU Time)? At this time the recharge was interrupted.
Thank you in advance.

Dear
Filomena Carusone
,
We are sending this email regarding a problem with your charger:
MP / R9 170002722
which led to the opened ticket:
0469599
.
Problem description: "
We opened the ticket 0468841 a few days ago because a customer tried to charge the car on the charger n. 170002722 thru Type 2 plug, but the recharge was automatically interrupted.

We have checked the previous ticket and according to the last message:
"... For us to troubleshoot and analyse, we need to check a specific set of logs that are only available during a short period of time. I tried to get them but unsucessfully. If you find this behaviour again, please report back to us and we will immediately get the logs so that we can find a solution..."
According to the message above unfortunately it's not possible to download the specific set of logs that allows us to understand better the root cause of this issue. In case you have a similar issue please let us know as soon as possible in order to assure that the specific logs are reachable.
We really appreciate your help and look forward to getting this sorted out soon!
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: ID0469599-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002722] CU Logs Check CRM:00263000317
additional_info.body:
Hello Filomena, good afternoon.
As mentioned in the previous ticket, we found the problem but we don't have the SECC parameters to understand what the root cause is.
What happens here is that the AC outlet, since it's very basic, it doesn't have any capturing of information besides the last reported.
What we need here is when the charging session fails again, before anybody tries to charge again, let us know so that we can capture those parameters and have R&D find the root cause.
For now, since there is nothing we can do, I will close the ticket and proceed with the error in the other opened one.
Thank you
Best regards,
Francisco
